Welcome to I’d Like to Know, a Bible Q&A program on SUMtv featuring Seventh-day Adventist pastors, including Pastor Stephen Bohr, President of SUMtv. Each episode explores Scripture to provide clear, biblically-based answers to your questions, offering spiritual guidance and practical wisdom.
